entries.note: Pre-advised: the shipper sent the waybill's data before handing the parcel over.
The goods reached a site: the gateway in Guangzhou, then the delivery depot in Japan.
The house waybill was entered for the air shipment, after the parcel reached the gateway.

entries.wording: 向目的地国家发送数据
entries.note: The parcel's data was sent to the destination country ahead of its arrival.
Import clearance in the destination country.

entries.note: A courier scanned the parcel to prepare its delivery, the minute it went to the delivering carrier; the delivery came a day later, so it is not read as out for delivery.

entries.note: Handed to a third party for delivery, whose delivery information comes back on later rows. The reply names neither that carrier nor a number for it.
The delivering carrier's status changed, without saying what it is: the parcel keeps the stage it had.
The record of the recipient's signature.
